name: Propeller 10 x 4.5 two-blade, pusher type (mounted)

spec: Same rotation as the mounted prop

notes: Powers the four servos only. Never from the ESC.

name: Logic BEC 5 V / 3 A

name: Power leads, XT60 pair, 14 AWG silicone
